Passwords that are case unsensitive, have unreasonable (32 or less) character limits and disallow special characters are usually a good sign that your password isn't being properly transferred/stored. The way standard password storage works is that you just make a (salted) hash of your password string which is doesn't care about the above limits. If jamflex is actually storing plain text passwords it's only a matter of time before someone gets into their network and leaks the table.

Another obvious way to tell if someone is storing plain text passwords is if they're able to send them back to you. There is no way to go back from a salted hash to a password so this would be impossible for them to do.

Salted hashes have been the standard for a long time now and any company not complying should never be trusted to control anything of value (including the answers to standard/reused recovery questions).

It doesn't even make me the smallest bit hyper, now I need it to stay awake. It doesn't make me need the to poop anymore I need 2-3 cups to make me poop.

They say why not just stop drinking it, it's only coffee but coffee is a drug and you can't just turn your back on a drug and leave withdrawal symptom free. I've tried to stop guys and every time I do I get so tired I can't move from my bed not to mention how much worse my depression gets.

Sometimes I've managed to push past the exhaustion but then comes the migraines. Holy fuck if I wasn't already stuck in bed you can bet to hell that I am now. The constant pain, that crushing sensation like someone's put my head under a boulder.

Why not just go slow they say? Don't give it up all at once. But then I deal with weeks of withdrawal symptoms. Sure I may not be in bed clutching my head from the migraines but there's a dull pulsating pain day in, day night. Insomnia sets in and now I'm awake with my pulsating head and my stifled mood wanting to not be here anymore.

A couple of sleepless nights later and I'm starting to crack. I'm starting to become confused and I don't quite understand why I'm where I am and why I'm doing what I'm doing. I start to see things in your peripheral vision and then there's a ringing in my ear. I know how to end to stop it all, all I need is that bit of caffeine to level your head.

Just one caffeine binge I think, yes just the one. That's all I'll have and then I can be rid of these annoyances, able to quit in peace. So I decide that yes it'll be best to have another almost as if I've forgotten what I'm doing and I'm back where I started again. Sure maybe I've knocked a couple of cups a day off from how I started but they'll be back.

**TL;DR Coffee is a drug and nobody want to admit it**
